predecessors.name: Yangshao culture
predecessors.text: the Yangshao country that passes to the Longshan in 3000 BCE: the Wei valley, Shanxi, Henan and southern Hebei, without Majiayao Gansu

predecessors.name: Dawenkou culture
predecessors.text: the Dawenkou land of Shandong and northern Jiangsu, the Shandong Longshan 'classic' area

successors.name: Erlitou Culture
successors.text: the central area that became the Erlitou culture: 'southern Shanxi and western Henan'

successors.name: Yueshi culture
successors.text: Shandong, where the Longshan was 'succeeded by the Bronze Age Yueshi culture'

ledger.x: 3000 BCE: the Longshan culture rises on the Yangshao country.
2600 BCE: the Dawenkou gives way to the Shandong Longshan.
About 2000 BCE: the outer Longshan settlements are abandoned.
1900 BCE: the Longshan gives way to the Erlitou culture in western Henan and southern Shanxi and to the Yueshi culture in Shandong.

certainty.note: No border is recorded: the culture is known from sites and pottery, and the page lists variants by province only.
